Perfect! All 63 tests pass. I've added:

✅ **`src/numbering.js`** with `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)`
- Calculates the next invoice number in format INV-<year>-<counter>
- Counter is 4-digit zero-padded, starting at 0001
- Counter resets every year
- Ignores numbers from other years
- Works with unordered number lists

✅ **`issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)`** in src/invoices.js
- Sets the invoice number using nextInvoiceNumber
- Changes status from 'draft' to 'issued'
- Returns ok(newInvoice) or fail(NOT_DRAFT)
- Preserves all other invoice data
- Doesn't mutate the original invoice

✅ **Comprehensive tests** covering:
- First number generation for a year
- Counter incrementing with various existing numbers
- Year transitions and multi-year data
- Proper zero-padding of counters (0001, 0010, 0100, 1000, etc.)
- High counter values
- Error handling for non-draft invoices
- Data preservation and immutability

The invoice numbering system is ready!
